text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Tuesday.
- During a visit to Hungary, President Franjo Tudjman reiterates his stand that Croatia will not be pushed into any new Balkan associations.
- Speculation of a meeting between Tudjman and Bosnian collective presidency chairman Alija Izetbegovic by mid-May in Croatia.
- Inclement weather gripping Croatia has brought traffic in the northwestern sections of the country to virtual standstill.
- Shares of 518 companies worth 12.5 billion kuna are to be offered to 400,000 victims of the war through coupon privatisation.
- Some 100,000 disabled have been registered in Croatia.
- The Adriatic coast is getting ready to accommodate an expected 4.5 million tourists in the upcoming season.
